name: jyu_slam_fly
desc: Same character, same colors and cream pattern. New pose: he is leaping straight sideways to the left in the air in a full-body slam, the broad chest and the huge round belly thrust forward to lead, the body almost horizontal, both arms swung back behind him, the legs trailing behind, a tail of thick paint streaming and dripping off behind him. The face is blank and expressionless. Same outline and pixel art style.
